name: PinInput
label: Pin input
description: Segmented one-time-code input with auto-advance, paste support, and completion callback.

props.name: length
props.description: Number of cells, one character each

props.name: value
props.description: Current code (controlled) — character at index n renders in cell n

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Convenience callback receiving the joined code whenever any cell changes.
There is no single native `onChange` here: the control is a group of
one-character inputs, so the value callback is the primary API.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Fires once when every cell is filled, with the complete code

props.name: mask
props.description: Render cells as password fields, hiding the entered characters

props.name: format
props.description: Accepted characters — `numeric` rejects non-digits and sets a numeric keyboard

props.name: label
props.description: Label text rendered above the cells; also names the group for screen readers

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper or error message displayed below the cells

props.name: error
props.description: Error state — recolours cell borders and the helper text

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the whole control is disabled

props.name: name
props.description:
Form field name. When set, the joined code submits with an enclosing form
through a hidden input, nothing while disabled. The cells themselves
carry no name.

props.name: cellLabel
props.description:
Accessible name of each cell, given its 1-based position and the cell count.
Defaults to "Digit <position> of <count>" for the numeric format and
"Character <position> of <count>" for alphanumeric.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes — applied to the wrapper, not the cells
